tracked_evidence_scan.method: Parse tracked evidence JSON and count exact top-level schema values; templates, source constants, Markdown, and test fixtures do not qualify as signed records.

blocking_reasons: No pre-existing independent governance bootstrap trust is activated in policy and compiled production verifier state.
No signed D/A/B/C compatibility qualification records exist in tracked evidence.
No independently signed rollback approval, external attestation, or rollback qualification records exist in tracked evidence.
Repository governance exposes one admin collaborator and no independent deployment or consumer-owner authority.
A successful CI run proves repository checks only and cannot establish deployment observation, consumer approval, trusted time, or release qualification.

required_external_sequence: Establish a pre-existing independent release-security/change-control governance bootstrap root in compiled production trust.
Deploy the content-addressed verifier and retain independently auditable non-backfillable activation/time evidence.
Sign trust-activation record D with a positive trust epoch and three mutually independent Ed25519 authorities.
Observe the real bounded compatibility release and sign record A after D activation.
Obtain independent consumer-owner approval B for the exact qualified deletion build plan.
Deploy only the B-approved build and obtain post-deployment observer attestation C.
Complete the separate rollback approval, external attestation, qualification, and strict verification chain.
Re-run final repository gates, close durable-event-runtime, and only then archive harness-workflow-graph-runtime.
